name: tashi-solo
description: Claude Code plugins by gvmatrosov — small tools made in daily work on a real product, from a phone as often as a laptop.

plugins.name: tap2line
plugins.description: Stop paying Claude Code to search for code you can point at: tap any element in your running app — web, mobile, desktop — and its source line is on your clipboard.

plugins.name: autobuffer
plugins.description: Everything Claude gives you to copy lands on your clipboard by itself — over SSH, through tmux, from a phone.

plugins.name: threadbook
plugins.description: Keep talking to your live Claude Code session from your phone: a private notebook page, one thread per point, answered by the same session with its full memory.
